messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: p99 latency breach detected for dedicated-eu-pool-3. Current p99=12.8s (SLO=2.0s). Streaming stalls spike, queue depth rising. Autoscaler appears delayed. Paging on-call: @Alice Chen. Runbook: https://runbooks.redwood/internal/dedicated-p99-burst

Alice Chen: Ack, I'm on. Gathering initial context. Which customers hit this? Any customer-visible errors?

Evan Morgan: CS -- two mid-market customers reported streaming stalls and partial disconnects ~2:05 UTC. One notes repeated 10-30s stalls. Escalated from support.

Ben Ruiz: I'm pulling metrics now. Grafana panel: dedicated-eu-pool-3 -> queue_depth trending up (~1800), inflight requests spiking. Autoscaler decision latency = 45s. Hotshot warmup failure logs show repeated 'warmup timeout' for new slots.

Cara Patel: Likely autoscaler handshake/warmup delay. Cold KV cache + model init for large context causing slot not usable until full warmup finish. That explains p99 tail. Suggest immediate manual scale + fallback to quantized model variant for streaming routes.

Alice Chen: Agreed. Steps: 1) manual scale +4 GPUs 2) enable burst-fallback model variant 3) apply temporary route throttle for low-priority customers 4) notify customers. Who can run the scale?

Fiona Blake: I can run scale. Running command now:
```
redwoodctl pools scale --pool dedicated-eu-pool-3 --add 4 --reason "manual scale for p99 breach"
```

ora-deploy-bot: scale job queued (job id: sj-20240315-0921). Allocating resources.

Ben Ruiz: While that runs, pushing a temporary route policy to divert non-SLA traffic:
```
redwoodctl routes patch --selector "tier!=enterprise" --set-policy burst-fallback --duration 15m
```

Gus Tran: Support message drafted: "We're seeing elevated latency in EU dedicated pools, mitigation in progress. If you're seeing streaming stalls please reply with request IDs." Shall I send?

Evan Morgan: Send now to affected customers, include note about best-effort reroute and ETA 15-30m.

Fiona Blake: Scale job completed, nodes provisioning. Observability: new nodes initializing, warmup logs show model loads starting. Warmup still slow for large-context models.

Cara Patel: Activate fallback model variant on the runtime to avoid heavy init. Command:
```
redwoodctl rollout set-variant --pool dedicated-eu-pool-3 --route "streaming/*" --model "gptx-7b-quant" --traffic 100
```

Ben Ruiz: Variant applied. Metrics: token generation throughput increased slightly. p95 improving but p99 still elevated due to in-flight slow requests.

Alice Chen: Also throttle queue to bound tail amplification. Applying per-pool queue_depth_limit=1000. Fiona, can you patch?

Fiona Blake: Patched:
```
kubectl -n inference patch config dedicated-eu-pool-3 --type merge -p '{"spec":{"queue_depth_limit":1000}}'
```
Queue gating now active. Dropped non-priority new requests to backlog.

Ben Ruiz: Good signal: queue_depth trending down from 1800 -> 700 over last 90s. p99 trending toward 3.1s. Still above SLO but improving.

ora-deploy-bot: autoscaler manual override in effect for 20m to prevent scale-down during warmup.

Gus Tran: Notifying customers with update: we applied mitigations and expect p99 to return to normal within 20 minutes.

Evan Morgan: Customer reply: one customer reports streaming resumed but saw a single 22s stall. They want root cause. We'll prepare post-incident summary.

Cara Patel: Collecting traces for representative streaming requests. Looks like the stalls correlate with model init events on newly provisioned slots. We need to improve warmup handoff and pre-warm heuristics in next sprint.

Ben Ruiz: Telemetry snapshot: scale-up started @1719901255, nodes ready @1719901320, fallback variant traffic shifted @1719901340. p99 timeline: peak 12.8s -> 6.2s -> 2.4s -> 1.9s.

Alice Chen: Current check: p99=1.9s, p95=0.45s, queue_depth stable ~150. Confirming customer impact minimal now. I'm going to mark mitigation complete and start postmortem.

Fiona Blake: Rolling back temporary route throttle and queue patch in 5m.

ora-deploy-bot: route patch reverted, queue_depth_limit reset to default.

Alice Chen: Thank you all. Actions: - Postmortem owner: Cara Patel - Tasks: improve autoscaler handshake, add pre-warm for large-context models, add runbook step to fallback to quantized variant automatically - Customer comms: Evan to send summary + timeline.

Evan Morgan: Sending customer summary now.

Alice Chen: Incident resolved. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
